package.name: gps_ins_pkg
package.description: EKF-based GPS+IMU localization stack (KF-1) for TurtleBot3 Burger. Runs ekf_local (continuous odom+IMU EKF, publishes odom to base_footprint TF), ekf_filter_node_gps_imu (global GPS+IMU EKF, output /odometry/global), navsat_transform (GPS lat/lon to ENU frame, output /odometry/gps), and the fixed-weight complementary filter node (KF1+KF2, output /odometry/fused).
